title: A fresh network's upgrade ledger: protocol 0 to 30 and base reserve 0.5 XLM
pattern: The first upgrade of a fresh standalone network sets the protocol to 30 and the base reserve in one ledger; crossing the Soroban protocol creates every Soroban config setting at its initial value, all in upgradesProcessing. Its change order differs in every core run (20 of 20), its content never.

hazards.placement: LEDGER_UPGRADE_VERSION 0 -> 30 and LEDGER_UPGRADE_BASE_RESERVE in one ledger; initial ConfigSettingEntry rows created
upgradesProcessing changes in a different order in every core run

facts.says: One upgrade sets the base reserve to 5000000 stroops.
The initial contract_max_size_bytes setting is created.
